# Production Readiness Gate 🟡 IN PROGRESS

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/prod_readiness.py --markdown` (#2121). Do not edit by hand. -->

The production-readiness program ([#2121](https://github.com/generalbots/generalbots/issues/2121)) is only credible if its claims are executable. This page is generated from `scripts/prod_readiness.py`, the single gate that runs every readiness check the repository owns and reports one row per check with the issue that owns it.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **PASS** | the check ran and passed |
| **FAIL** | the check ran and failed — a regression; CI fails |
| **SKIP** | the gate does not exist yet — the row names the issue and what must land |

Current run: **6 PASS · 1 FAIL · 7 SKIP** of 14 checks.

## How to run it

```bash
python3 scripts/prod_readiness.py                  # table, exit 1 on FAIL
python3 scripts/prod_readiness.py --json           # machine output
python3 scripts/prod_readiness.py --markdown       # rewrite this page
python3 scripts/prod_readiness.py --check-markdown # fail when this page drifts
```

CI runs it as the `prod-readiness` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: any **FAIL** fails the build, and so does a page that no longer matches the gate output. Regenerate the page instead of editing it.

A **SKIP** row is the to-do list for the program: the owning issue lands the check (a script, a committed baseline or a regression test), and the row flips to **PASS** on the next run without touching this page by hand.
